summary: Iteration 45 - Booking management features tested (backend + frontend). 18/18 backend tests PASS. Frontend: 7/9 checks pass. Identified 1 critical race condition bug in service/[id].tsx that prevents booking lists from loading in the coach modal and user calendar-outline from showing.

ui_bugs.issue: statusColors map is missing 'accepted' and 'refused' entries. These statuses fall back to Colors.muted (gray) instead of green/red. Add: `accepted: Colors.primary, refused: Colors.destructive`

integration_issues.issue: RACE CONDITION: loadService() is called in useEffect([id]) but user context (from AuthContext) may not be ready on first render (async localStorage restore). The `if (user)` check inside loadService fails silently, so serviceBookings is NEVER populated. Result: coach modal always shows 'Demandes reçues (0)', user's calendar-outline never appears even when bookings exist.

action_items: CRITICAL FIX - service/[id].tsx line 123: Change `useEffect(() => { if (id) loadService(); }, [id]);` to `useEffect(() => { if (id) loadService(); }, [id, user?.user_id]);` — This fixes the race condition where user context isn't ready when loadService runs, causing serviceBookings to never be populated. Impacts: coach modal (shows 0 bookings instead of pending/all bookings) AND user calendar-outline (not shown even when user has bookings for the service).
LOW PRIORITY - booking/[id].tsx: Add 'accepted' and 'refused' to statusColors map so they display with meaningful colors (green/red) instead of falling back to Colors.muted.
critical_code_review_comments: RACE CONDITION in service/[id].tsx: `useEffect(() => { if (id) loadService(); }, [id])` - loadService contains `if (user) { fetch bookings... }` but user is async (restored from localStorage). When user navigates directly to /service/[id], user=null at first render → bookings never fetched. Fix: add user?.user_id to deps array.
booking/[id].tsx statusColors missing 'accepted'/'refused' keys → gray badge for these statuses.
_change_booking_status in booking_routes.py: The BOOKING_FIELDS used in the return query doesn't include 'updated_at' but that's fine since it's not in the model. No issue.
The modal close button properly has testID='close-requests-modal'. All interactive elements have data-testid attributes.

rca_of_issue.bug: Race condition in service/[id].tsx serviceBookings loading
rca_of_issue.root_cause: useEffect(() => { if (id) loadService(); }, [id]) runs once when component mounts. Inside loadService(), user context from useAuth() is checked with `if (user)`. However, when navigating directly to /service/[id] (e.g., fresh page load or Playwright navigation), the AuthContext restores user from AsyncStorage/localStorage asynchronously. By the time loadService() runs, user may still be null. The fetch for bookings is inside `if (user)` so it never executes. Since useEffect only depends on [id], it never re-runs when user is later set.
reproduction_steps: 1. Navigate directly to /service/svc_demo001 as logged-in coach (Playwright goto or hard refresh)
2. Wait 4-5 seconds for page to fully load
4. Modal shows 'Demandes reçues (0)' even though there are active bookings
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Change line 123 in service/[id].tsx: `useEffect(() => { if (id) loadService(); }, [id]);` → `useEffect(() => { if (id) loadService(); }, [id, user?.user_id]);` This will re-run loadService when user becomes available, which will then fetch the bookings properly.
